eyebrow: A real brief can be five lines
code:
Workload: Internal HR portal
Expected users: ~400 employees, peak 9-10am
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II (HR data)
Budget: $800/mo infrastructure cap
Availability: 99.5% during business hours
caption: Enough to start sizing and choosing a provider — guessing at any one line isn't.
